messages:
Priya Raman: Sharing new comps for a pared-down action bar under each chat bubble. Idea: single-row actions — Stop (labelled), More (menu), and a small cost badge that expands. Screenshot: https://redwood.internal/s/def456
Tom Baker: Nice. My concern: cost badge could be noisy during streaming. Can the badge show a stable estimate and then expand on click for a live breakdown?
Maya Li: Yes — collapsed state shows estimate like '$0.03'. Expanded state shows tokens: input / output / total + model label. Also show last-updated time.
Owen Park: Accessibility note: the More menu must be keyboard reachable and the expanded cost panel should be a real dialog with focus trap. Use aria-modal and `role=dialog`.
Sofia Ruiz: UX nit: prefer 'Cost' over 'Estimate' for the badge label? Non-technical users found 'estimate' ambiguous in testing. Also, color contrast for the green badge in our comps is too low on hover.
Priya Raman: Good point — we'll use 'Cost' and bump the color to 4.5:1. Also switching the secondary action to a kebab menu instead of an exposed 'Regenerate' button so primary Stop is dominant.
Tom Baker: Keyboard shortcut proposal: ESC to stop, Cmd+R to regenerate. Need product sign-off — Cmd+R conflicts in browser refresh. Maybe Ctrl+Enter to regenerate? Thoughts?
Maya Li: Ctrl+Enter sounds safer cross-platform. Add a tooltip with the shortcut and ensure it's customizable in settings.
Owen Park: Implementation challenge: streaming chunks frequently update the token total. Suggest backend sends `cost_snapshot` events at 300ms intervals when `stream_cost=true`. Frontend should animate the badge number only on change flashes, not every chunk.
Priya Raman: Backend API team, can we expose `stream_cost=true` toggle? Example: GET /v1/reply?stream=true&stream_cost=true
ui-bot: CI note: Added issue INF-4823 to backend board for `stream_cost` endpoint behavior.
Sofia Ruiz: Microcopy: change tooltip to 'Stop generation' for screen readers, visible label stays 'Stop'. For the kebab menu item, use 'Regenerate response' not just 'Regenerate'.
Tom Baker: Analytics: record `cost_panel_opened`, `regen_used`, `stop_via_shortcut`. Add `high_cost_regen_confirm` when cost > $0.50 and user proceeds.
Priya Raman: Product decision: soft confirm if cost > $0.50. UI: small modal "This regenerate may cost ~$0.62. Proceed?" with Proceed / Cancel. No hard blocks.
Maya Li: One more: prompt library quick-insert — add a tiny plus icon inside the More menu to insert the original prompt into composer. That keeps regen in context of the prompt deck.
Priya Raman: Great — I'll update Figma and post new frames. Can design & eng review accessibility checklist after I push? Tag me when done. :sparkles:
